settings.question: When does the UAE National Day sale start and end?
settings.answer: The UAE National Day Offer starts on 1 December at 12:00 AM and ends on 6 December at 12:00 AM, UAE time. That gives you five full days, from 1 to 5 December, to shop.

settings.question: How much can I save in the National Day perfume sale?
settings.answer: You can save up to 50% on selected perfumes. The exact discount depends on the product and is shown on each product page.

settings.question: Do I need a discount code?
settings.answer: No. Offer prices are already applied to the products, so you'll see the discounted price straight away with no code to enter.

settings.question: Can I use WELCOME10 with the National Day Offer?
settings.answer: No. The WELCOME10 welcome discount can't be combined with National Day offer prices.

settings.question: Is delivery free during the offer?
settings.answer: Yes, on orders above AED 300. Orders below AED 300 have a delivery fee of AED 12. UAE orders usually arrive within 1 to 4 business days.

settings.question: Do you deliver National Day offers to Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah?
settings.answer: Yes. We deliver offer orders across the UAE, including Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. Orders usually arrive within 1 to 4 business days, and delivery is free on orders above AED 300.

settings.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
settings.answer: Yes. Cash on Delivery is available across the UAE, and you can also pay securely by credit or debit card.

settings.question: Which brands are part of the National Day offer?
settings.answer: The offer covers hundreds of perfumes from many brands, including Arabic, oud and designer-inspired houses. Use the Brand filter on this page to see every brand on offer.

settings.question: Are the offer perfumes authentic?
settings.answer: Yes. Every perfume at The Fragrance Secrets, including all offer items, is 100% authentic, sourced from trusted suppliers, and sealed and checked before dispatch.

settings.question: Will the offer items sell out?
settings.answer: Offer stock is limited and available while it lasts, so we recommend ordering your favourites early.
